title: Functional Bias and Tangent-Space Geometry in Variational Inference
summary: Variational inference approximates Bayesian posterior distributions by projecting onto a tractable family of distributions. While most theoretical analyses evaluate the quality of this approximation using global divergence measures, many applications rely on specific posterior summaries such as expectations, variances, or tail probabilities. We develop a geometric framework for analyzing the bias of posterior functionals under variational approximations.
